scope: Twelve preselected native pixels, no adaptive replacement; actual frozen Float32 mesh, CPU Three rays and affine caster reference, not GPU bit/raster parity or unbiased frequency/art assessment

caster.selection: first FrontSide hit / maximum RAW solar height at texel centre, then minimum of that winning plane (not max plane minimum)

shadow.controlCaveat: Unchanged control RGB alone does not prove visibility=1; diffuse/rounding may hide a shadow.

physicalSunRay.scope: Occlusion of this actual mesh from receiver+1cm toward Sun; no other objects, no GPU raster/float32 parity claim

rows.interpretation: CPU shadow and physical blocker both present
